body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified on the cr/testkit branch base.
Defects, as facts:
(a) packages/core/index.d.ts ends with `declare module '@adlc/core/test-kit' { ... }`. Because index.d.ts is a module file, TypeScript treats that block as an augmentation of an untyped subpath, so every strict nodenext consumer of `@adlc/core` fails with TS2665, and `import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'` stays an implicit any (TS7016).
(b) scripts/test/type-declarations.test.mjs compiles only packages/tickets/index.d.ts, so the core declarations were never compiled by any gate.
(c) packages/core/lib/test-kit.mjs tmp()/gitRepo() silently register no cleanup when the first argument has no callable .after (nothing, null, a prefix string, an options object, or the SuiteContext a describe-level before() receives); the directory is minted and leaks. The tmp-fixture boundary guard only scans files containing `mkdtempSync`, so such leaks are invisible to it.
(d) Callers relied on that context-less form: the autopilot coverage gate (spec-coverage.test.mjs) calls exported criterion functions with no argument, leaking ap-tools-*/ap-paths-*/ap-dryrun-ssh-* directories on every gate run; context-handoff supervise-cli-support fixture(t) was called as fixture() everywhere; review-calibration minted describe-level fixtures with tmp('prefix'); autopilot scratch() and prosecute helpers defaulted the context to null.
(e) gitRepo() does not disable automatic/detached gc and the kit removes fixtures with a single non-retrying rmSync, so a detached maintenance child can race removal (ENOTEMPTY).
(f) packages/core/test/core.test.mjs carried a per-test t.after polyfill and a 'regression test' that re-implemented the polyfill inline instead of exercising it.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/core`: lib/test-kit.mjs (fixture helpers), index.d.ts (package root types), package.json exports map. Tests: `npm test -w packages/core`. scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs is frozen and is not edited: the leak class is closed at the source instead.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. tmp(t, prefix) and gitRepo(t, options) throw a TypeError whose message contains `requires a test context` when `t` has no callable `.after`, before creating anything. tmp registers its removal hook BEFORE minting, so a context that refuses registration leaves nothing behind. gitRepo accepts options as an object or a prefix string in the second position only.
2. Fixture removal uses exported frozen FIXTURE_RM_OPTIONS `{ recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 10, retryDelay: 50 }`. gitRepo sets gc.auto=0 and gc.autoDetach=false alongside commit.gpgsign=false.
3. New exports: createScope() -> frozen `{ after, dispose }` (hooks run last-first on dispose, every hook runs, first failure rethrown, registration after dispose throws); withScopedContext(fn) runs fn(scope) and disposes it when fn settles (fn's error wins over a cleanup error).
4. Types: remove the augmentation block from index.d.ts (keep type re-exports from './lib/test-kit.mjs'); ship lib/test-kit.d.mts; export map `"./test-kit": { "types": "./lib/test-kit.d.mts", "default": "./lib/test-kit.mjs" }`. The consumer compile gate derives its package list from every packages/*/package.json with a `types` field and every export-map entry carrying a `types` condition.
5. Callers: the autopilot coverage gate invokes criterion functions through helpers/run-registered.mjs (withScopedContext); autopilot scratch() and prosecute helpers default to a file-level createScope() drained by a root after() hook; supervise-cli tests pass `t` to fixture(t); review-calibration describe blocks use createScope() + `after(() => scope.dispose())`; continue-cli-support withTempRepo removes its directory in a finally. Dead `if (!t?.after) rmSync(...)` fallbacks are removed.
6. core.test.mjs uses node:test's test directly; the polyfill and its self-referential test are deleted (on a runtime without t.after, tmp now throws instead of leaking).
7. Documentation: add a test-kit section to packages/core/README.md and the same text in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 tmp/gitRepo throw and mint nothing without a context; createScope/withScopedContext semantics; gc config and retrying removal. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/test-kit-fail-closed.test.mjs`
- AC2 Every typed package export, including @adlc/core and @adlc/core/test-kit, compiles for a strict nodenext consumer and test-kit is not an implicit any. verify: `node --test scripts/test/typed-package-consumers.test.mjs`
- AC3 Criterion functions run the way the autopilot gate runs them leave nothing in TMPDIR. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/gate-fixture-scope.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing suites green. verify: `npm test -w packages/core && npm test -w packages/autopilot && npm test -w packages/context-handoff && npm test -w packages/review-calibration && npm test -w packages/prosecute && node --test scripts/test/type-declarations.test.mjs scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC5 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "withScopedContext" packages/core/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: editing scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs; the per-file t.after polyfills in scripts/test (toolkit-floor, rails-guard-ci, check-reviewer-directed-comments); runBin behaviour.
title: core test-kit: correct types, fail closed without a test context, and fix the callers that leak
